This is a bar chart displaying a time series of data from January 2019 to January 2022. The Y-axis represents numerical values ranging from 0 to 140,000, while the X-axis represents time in monthly increments. The chart shows a gradual increase in values peaking around early 2020, followed by a steady decline through 2021 and into early 2022. Key takeaway: The data shows a clear upward trend until early 2020, followed by a sustained downward trend for the remainder of the observed period.


Source: Department of Employment, Thailand (2022)
